name: Chicken Clucking for a Mint
summary: At Hallow's End, Innkeeper Firebrew asks visitors in Ironforge to cluck for a mint meant for Jesper, a young orphan in Stormwind. Alliance champions gather holiday sweets from their capitals to bring him cheer.

sections.title: A Hallow's End Tradition
sections.body: Young Jesper in Stormwind longs for Hallow's End sweets, though sickness and orphanhood keep him from joining the festivities. Alliance champions gather treats for him from innkeepers in the Alliance capitals, giving seasoned adventurers a reason to go door to door during the harvest-to-winter celebration.

sections.title: Innkeeper Firebrew's Price
sections.body: At the Stonefire Tavern in Ironforge's Commons, Innkeeper Firebrew keeps the Ironforge Mints. Asking politely is not enough; visitors must flap their arms and cluck like chickens before he parts with one. The performance gives the tavern's patrons a laugh, and the mint helps bring holiday cheer to Jesper.

faq.q: Why does Innkeeper Firebrew want me to cluck like a chicken?
aliases: why do i have to cluck
faq.answer: Innkeeper Firebrew asks you to cluck because Hallow's End calls for a little playful theater. Seasoned adventurers are too old to trick-or-treat, so he trades an Ironforge Mint for a comical performance and a laugh from the tavern patrons.

faq.q: Who is Jesper and why am I getting mints for him?
faq.answer: Jesper is a young, sick orphan in Stormwind who longs for Hallow's End sweets. Alliance champions collect four special candies from the major Alliance cities, including the Ironforge Mint from Dun Morogh, to bring him holiday cheer.

faq.q: Where does this quest fit into the Hallow's End holiday?
faq.answer: The Ironforge Mint is one of four regional candies gathered for Jesper during Hallow's End. Innkeepers in Stormwind and Darnassus, along with Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge, also ask for a specific theatrical gesture before giving up their city's candy.

faq.q: Where can I find Innkeeper Firebrew?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Firebrew can be found at the Stonefire Tavern in Ironforge's Commons, serving drinks and boarding travelers.

faq.q: What do I receive for clucking?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Firebrew gives you an Ironforge Mint, a holiday candy to take back to Stormwind for Jesper's Hallow's End assortment.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this task?
faq.answer: No, only Alliance champions can take part. Horde adventurers gather treats for the orphan Spoops from innkeepers in Orgrimmar, the Undercity, and Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you carry Ironforge's hospitality to Stormwind to cheer an orphaned child.
As a dwarf, you know Ironforge's festival traditions leave room for a joke, and Firebrew's demand shows that no patron takes themselves too seriously.
